description.value: You awaken to the Force, learning two at-will force powers immediately. At 3rd level you learn one 1st-level force power, usable once per long rest; at 5th level you learn one 2nd-level force power, also usable once per long rest. Your forcecasting ability is Wisdom or Charisma, depending on the alignment of the power. Taking this feat also removes the Force-Insensitive trait, if you had it.
